import sys
import re

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # first token is n (ignored), second token is input string
    # n = int(data[0])  # not used
    input_str = data[1]

    pattern = r'\([\w_]*\)'
    # parts outside parentheses
    outside_parts = re.split(pattern, input_str)
    longest_outside = 0
    for part in outside_parts:
        if part:
            words = part.split('_')
            longest_outside = max(longest_outside, max((len(w) for w in words), default=0))

    # inside parentheses
    matches = re.findall(pattern, input_str)
    number_inside = 0
    for m in matches:
        inner = m[1:-1]  # remove '(' and ')'
        if inner:
            parts = inner.split('_')
            number_inside += sum(1 for p in parts if p)

    print(f"{longest_outside} {number_inside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
